$\blueD{65\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{20}$ is the same as $\blueD{65\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{20}$.

To solve $\blueD{65\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{20}$, we need to convert $\blueD{65\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{65\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{65}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{65\div 100=0.65}$.

 $\blueD{65\%= \dfrac{65}{100} = 0.65}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{65\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{20}&=\blueD{\dfrac{65}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{20}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.65}\cdot\maroonD{20}\\\\
&=13
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

$\dfrac{65}{100}\div 20=0.0325$

The expression $\dfrac{65}{100}\div 20$ is **not** equivalent to $65\%$ of $20$.

$\dfrac{65}{20}\cdot 100=325$

The expression $\dfrac{65}{20}\cdot 100$ is **not** equivalent to $65\%$ of $20$.

$65\cdot 20=1{,}300$

The expression $65\cdot 20$ is **not** equivalent to $65\%$ of $20$.

The options that have the same value as $65\%$ of $20$ are:

- $\dfrac{65}{100}\cdot 20$
- $0.65\cdot 20$

question.content:
**Which of the following options have the same value as $65\%$ of $20$?**

choices.clue: We should multiply instead of divide by $20$.
This choice is $25$ times as large as $65\%$ of $20$.
This choice is $100$ times as large as $65\%$ of $20$.
